name: Apigee Extras
description: Umbrella project that extends the Apigee Edge integration with a Views bridge for developer apps and Bootstrap 5 theming for Apigee portal elements.
project_description: Apigee Extras is a small umbrella project that adds convenience features on top of the Apigee Edge module (Google's API management platform / developer portal). The base module ships no code of its own; it exists to declare the dependency on apigee_edge and to group two optional submodules: Apigee Extras Views, which exposes Apigee developer apps as a Views base table with field/query handlers, and Apigee Extras Bootstrap, which re-skins the Apigee status_property theme element as Bootstrap 5 badges.
